description: Members PerkCooldownHud patches. Harmony binds by name at runtime, so a rename in a game update would otherwise be a silent no-op.

properties.name: Show
properties.why: postfixed to true so the panel survives the cooldown

properties.name: ViewValue
properties.why: postfixed to Duration while cooling; vanilla runs negative

properties.name: BlinkOnChange
properties.why: narrowed to the active phase to stop a per-turn ping

properties.name: IsInActivePhase
properties.why: the active/cooldown discriminator every patch reads

properties.name: Duration
properties.why: reported as turns of cooldown remaining

methods.name: InitializeBackground
methods.why: the single place vanilla picks the red or green border

fields.name: _bg
fields.why: reached by name via Harmony FieldRefAccess, which throws at patch time if renamed

fields.name: _yellowBorder
fields.why: the game's own yellow sprite, reused as the cooling-down state

fields.name: _originalBgSprite
fields.why: OnPointerExit restores from this, so it must move too

fields.name: _effectWithViews
fields.why: identifies which effect a panel is currently showing
